description: Elections Commission - Presidential Elections Act, No. 15 of 1981 Mr. Gotabaya Rajapaksa  has been Declared Elected as the President of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
reasoning: This gazette content announces the declaration of Mr. Gotabaya Rajapaksa as the elected President of Sri Lanka, as notified by the Election Commission under the Presidential Elections Act. This is a formal declaration of an election result, which falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
